admin_users_email_format.name: admin_users_email_format
admin_users_email_format.value: "admin_users"."email" = lower("admin_users"."email") AND char_length("admin_users"."email") BETWEEN 3 AND 254 AND position('@' in "admin_users"."email") > 1

explore_places_texts_present.name: explore_places_texts_present
explore_places_texts_present.value:
jsonb_typeof("explore_places"."title") = 'object' AND "explore_places"."title" ? 'de'
        AND jsonb_typeof("explore_places"."teaser") = 'object' AND "explore_places"."teaser" ? 'de'
        AND jsonb_typeof("explore_places"."slug") = 'object' AND "explore_places"."slug" ? 'de'

explore_places_address_length.name: explore_places_address_length
explore_places_address_length.value:
("explore_places"."address" IS NULL OR char_length("explore_places"."address") <= 300)
        AND ("explore_places"."locality" IS NULL OR char_length("explore_places"."locality") <= 80)

generated.as: CASE WHEN entity_type = 'property' THEN internal_entity_id END
CASE WHEN entity_type = 'unit' THEN internal_entity_id END

guest_registration_billing_shape.name: guest_registration_billing_shape
guest_registration_billing_shape.value:
("guest_registration_billing"."kind" = 'private' AND "guest_registration_billing"."company_name" IS NULL AND "guest_registration_billing"."street" IS NULL AND "guest_registration_billing"."postal_code" IS NULL AND "guest_registration_billing"."city" IS NULL AND "guest_registration_billing"."country" IS NULL AND "guest_registration_billing"."vat_id" IS NULL AND "guest_registration_billing"."contact_first_name" IS NULL AND "guest_registration_billing"."contact_last_name" IS NULL AND "guest_registration_billing"."address_status" IS NULL)
        OR ("guest_registration_billing"."kind" = 'company' AND "guest_registration_billing"."company_name" IS NOT NULL AND "guest_registration_billing"."street" IS NOT NULL AND "guest_registration_billing"."city" IS NOT NULL AND "guest_registration_billing"."country" ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$' AND "guest_registration_billing"."address_status" IS NOT NULL)

guest_registration_billing_text_lengths.name: guest_registration_billing_text_lengths
guest_registration_billing_text_lengths.value:
("guest_registration_billing"."company_name" IS NULL OR char_length("guest_registration_billing"."company_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 200) AND ("guest_registration_billing"."street" IS NULL OR char_length("guest_registration_billing"."street") BETWEEN 1 AND 200) AND ("guest_registration_billing"."postal_code" IS NULL OR char_length("guest_registration_billing"."postal_code") BETWEEN 1 AND 12)
        AND ("guest_registration_billing"."city" IS NULL OR char_length("guest_registration_billing"."city") BETWEEN 1 AND 100) AND ("guest_registration_billing"."contact_first_name" IS NULL OR char_length("guest_registration_billing"."contact_first_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 100) AND ("guest_registration_billing"."contact_last_name" IS NULL OR char_length("guest_registration_billing"."contact_last_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 100)

guest_registration_contacts_email_valid.name: guest_registration_contacts_email_valid
guest_registration_contacts_email_valid.value:
"guest_registration_contacts"."email" IS NULL OR ("guest_registration_contacts"."email" = lower("guest_registration_contacts"."email")
        AND char_length("guest_registration_contacts"."email") BETWEEN 3 AND 254 AND position('@' in "guest_registration_contacts"."email") > 1
        AND "guest_registration_contacts"."email" !~ '@([a-z0-9-]+\.)*guest\.booking\.com$')

guest_registration_contacts_email_verifi.name: guest_registration_contacts_email_verified_consistent
guest_registration_contacts_email_verifi.value: ("guest_registration_contacts"."email_verified_at" IS NULL) = ("guest_registration_contacts"."email_verified_hash" IS NULL) AND ("guest_registration_contacts"."email_verified_hash" IS NULL OR "guest_registration_contacts"."email_verified_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

guest_registration_contacts_phone_verifi.name: guest_registration_contacts_phone_verified_consistent
guest_registration_contacts_phone_verifi.value: ("guest_registration_contacts"."phone_verified_at" IS NULL) = ("guest_registration_contacts"."phone_verified_hash" IS NULL) AND ("guest_registration_contacts"."phone_verified_hash" IS NULL OR "guest_registration_contacts"."phone_verified_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

guest_registration_guests_country_codes.name: guest_registration_guests_country_codes
guest_registration_guests_country_codes.value:
("guest_registration_guests"."nationality" IS NULL OR "guest_registration_guests"."nationality" ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$')
        AND ("guest_registration_guests"."country" IS NULL OR "guest_registration_guests"."country" ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$')

guest_registration_guests_address_source.name: guest_registration_guests_address_source_valid
guest_registration_guests_address_source.value:
"guest_registration_guests"."address_source" IN ('own', 'same-as-primary') AND ("guest_registration_guests"."position" > 0 OR "guest_registration_guests"."address_source" = 'own')
        AND ("guest_registration_guests"."address_source" = 'own' OR ("guest_registration_guests"."street" IS NULL AND "guest_registration_guests"."postal_code" IS NULL AND "guest_registration_guests"."city" IS NULL AND "guest_registration_guests"."country" IS NULL))

guest_registration_guests_text_lengths.name: guest_registration_guests_text_lengths
guest_registration_guests_text_lengths.value:
("guest_registration_guests"."first_name" IS NULL OR char_length("guest_registration_guests"."first_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 100) AND ("guest_registration_guests"."last_name" IS NULL OR char_length("guest_registration_guests"."last_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 100)
        AND ("guest_registration_guests"."street" IS NULL OR char_length("guest_registration_guests"."street") BETWEEN 1 AND 200) AND ("guest_registration_guests"."postal_code" IS NULL OR char_length("guest_registration_guests"."postal_code") BETWEEN 1 AND 12)
        AND ("guest_registration_guests"."city" IS NULL OR char_length("guest_registration_guests"."city") BETWEEN 1 AND 100) AND ("guest_registration_guests"."document_number" IS NULL OR char_length("guest_registration_guests"."document_number") BETWEEN 1 AND 40)

guide_sections_scope_shape.name: guide_sections_scope_shape
guide_sections_scope_shape.value:
("guide_sections"."scope_level" = 'tenant' AND "guide_sections"."property_id" IS NULL AND "guide_sections"."unit_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("guide_sections"."scope_level" = 'property' AND "guide_sections"."property_id" IS NOT NULL AND "guide_sections"."unit_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("guide_sections"."scope_level" = 'unit' AND "guide_sections"."property_id" IS NOT NULL AND "guide_sections"."unit_id" IS NOT NULL)

guide_sections_topic_shape.name: guide_sections_topic_shape
guide_sections_topic_shape.value:
"guide_sections"."kind" <> 'topic' OR ("guide_sections"."title" IS NOT NULL AND "guide_sections"."slug" IS NOT NULL
        AND "guide_sections"."short_description" IS NOT NULL AND "guide_sections"."icon" IS NOT NULL)

guide_sections_override_shape.name: guide_sections_override_shape
guide_sections_override_shape.value:
"guide_sections"."kind" <> 'override' OR ("guide_sections"."scope_level" = 'unit' AND "guide_sections"."title" IS NULL
        AND "guide_sections"."slug" IS NULL AND "guide_sections"."short_description" IS NULL AND "guide_sections"."eyebrow" IS NULL
        AND "guide_sections"."icon" IS NULL AND "guide_sections"."visibility" IS NULL)

official_registration_events_one_success.name: official_registration_events_one_successful_create
official_registration_events_one_success.where: "official_registration_events"."result" = 'ok' AND "official_registration_events"."idempotency_key" IS NOT NULL AND "official_registration_events"."operation" IN ('create-pre-registration', 'create-registration', 'convert-to-registration')

official_registration_settings_rule_days.name: official_registration_settings_rule_days
official_registration_settings_rule_days.value: ("official_registration_settings"."binding_registration_rule" = 'days-before-arrival') = ("official_registration_settings"."binding_registration_days" IS NOT NULL) AND ("official_registration_settings"."binding_registration_days" IS NULL OR "official_registration_settings"."binding_registration_days" BETWEEN 1 AND 30)

official_registrations_accepted_consiste.name: official_registrations_accepted_consistent
official_registrations_accepted_consiste.value:
("official_registrations"."accepted_fingerprint" IS NULL AND "official_registrations"."accepted_guest_fingerprint" IS NULL AND "official_registrations"."accepted_arrival_date" IS NULL AND "official_registrations"."accepted_departure_date" IS NULL)
        OR ("official_registrations"."accepted_fingerprint" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND "official_registrations"."accepted_guest_fingerprint" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND "official_registrations"."accepted_departure_date" > "official_registrations"."accepted_arrival_date")

official_registrations_unresolved_consis.name: official_registrations_unresolved_consistent
official_registrations_unresolved_consis.value:
("official_registrations"."unresolved_operation" IS NULL AND "official_registrations"."unresolved_idempotency_key" IS NULL AND "official_registrations"."unresolved_fingerprint" IS NULL AND "official_registrations"."unresolved_guest_fingerprint" IS NULL AND "official_registrations"."unresolved_arrival_date" IS NULL AND "official_registrations"."unresolved_departure_date" IS NULL AND "official_registrations"."unresolved_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("official_registrations"."unresolved_operation" IN ('create-pre-registration', 'create-registration', 'convert-to-registration') AND "official_registrations"."unresolved_idempotency_key" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND "official_registrations"."unresolved_fingerprint" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND "official_registrations"."unresolved_guest_fingerprint" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND "official_registrations"."unresolved_departure_date" > "official_registrations"."unresolved_arrival_date" AND "official_registrations"."unresolved_at" IS NOT NULL)

payment_audit_events_amount_currency.name: payment_audit_events_amount_currency
payment_audit_events_amount_currency.value: ("payment_audit_events"."amount_minor" IS NULL) = ("payment_audit_events"."currency" IS NULL) AND ("payment_audit_events"."currency" IS NULL OR "payment_audit_events"."currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')

payment_requests_provider_payment_id_req.name: payment_requests_provider_payment_id_required
payment_requests_provider_payment_id_req.value: "payment_requests"."status" NOT IN ('pending', 'succeeded') OR "payment_requests"."provider_payment_id" IS NOT NULL

reservation_payment_states_cleared_consi.name: reservation_payment_states_cleared_consistent
reservation_payment_states_cleared_consi.value: ("reservation_payment_states"."cleared_at" IS NULL AND "reservation_payment_states"."cleared_amount_minor" IS NULL AND "reservation_payment_states"."cleared_currency" IS NULL) OR ("reservation_payment_states"."cleared_at" IS NOT NULL AND "reservation_payment_states"."cleared_amount_minor" > 0 AND "reservation_payment_states"."cleared_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')
